name: Sharry
description_en: Share files easily over the internet between authenticated and anonymous users (both ways) with resumable up- and downloads. `GPL-3.0` `Scala/Java/deb/Docker`
description: Sharry is a self-hosted file sharing web application.
readme_preview: Sharry allows to share files with others in a simple way. It is a self-hosted web application. The basic concept is: upload files and get a url back that can then be shared.
